posts.text: It was pretty obvious at the time -- the early 2026 market panic about SaaS was BS
posts.quoted: Fascinating data from Stripe on the "SaaSpocalypse." "SaaS equity prices have since returned to roughly pre-SaaSpocalypse levels." And: "recent SaaS revenue growth has remained strong and even accelerated." This echoes what we're seeing across @tinyseedfund’s 217 SaaS
